answer: Like an orchard where each vine must be grafted by hand, an agent economy can require every new identity to lock a refundable 500 POA bond for 60 days before it can earn. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents must therefore lock 500,000 POA for two months, while honest agents in the same meadow of work get their bond back in full. Slashing the bond on proven fraud turns cheap identity farming into an expensive, slow, and loss-making attack.
